title: Photo Spec Check
description: Stops exam, passport and visa photos being rejected after upload by checking them against the portal's rules (UPSC, SSC, NTA, NEET and US visa presets, or your own): the real file type behind the name, KB, pixels, shape, print size, over-compression, face size and centring when a face box is passed, a background that isn't white and black-and-white photos, with a one-tap canvas fix that crops around the face, resizes and re-encodes into the KB window.
